name: Enterprise AI Evaluation, Safety and Deployment Decision Binding
constraints: WM-AI-003 owns one bounded evaluation instance with its applied plan, runs and results.
WM-AI-009 owns benchmark identity, release, task contract, item and split rules, metrics and validation.
WM-AI-008 owns a dated safety judgement for one pinned subject and context.
Decision rationale, authorized occurrence and issued instrument remain separate across WM-KNW-010, WM-ACT-024 and WM-REC-010.
Assessment acceptance never implies deployment authorization.
Model, context, benchmark, dataset, metric, scorer, incident or contamination changes trigger reevaluation or explicit transfer justification.
holds: Conditional Evaluation Protocol and standing authorization candidates remain unassigned.
Protocol, metric and decision ownership overlaps require reconciliation.
Independent Grok review and frozen audit remain pending.
